milestone: 0.1.5 release: session grouping plus session-scoped bulk archive
whatChanged: Review list groups items by session; the groups themselves stay collapsible and every artifact remains reachable.

A session group can be archived in one step. The host accepts only action=archive for a session-scoped bulk request and returns 400 otherwise, so the bulk path cannot be used to approve or return without a human decision.
Bulk archive is reversible per artifact; each archived item keeps its own history entry.

inProductVerification.environment: isolated DSH_HOME with a copy of the real 75-item daily-profile state

dshDefault.failure: The pnpm bundled with DSH inherits its registry from the user's npm configuration; on this machine that is registry.npmmirror.com. While the mirror answered 500 for this package, that path resolved the cached 0.1.3, and asking for 0.1.5 explicitly failed with ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION citing the mirror as the fetch source. Direct evidence comes from dsh's own pnpm log, not from inference.

registryControl.overrideFlagVerified: --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org resolved 0.1.5 in 7.9s with a fresh store
registryControl.notClaimed: why an npmrc-override range run still resolved 0.1.3; most likely pnpm metadata-cache reuse, unverified

releaseProcessNote: The 0.1.5 changelog lines were first written through a bash heredoc, which executed the backticked words as commands and silently dropped them from the text. The pin commit restores them. Release write-ups now use direct file writes, not shell heredocs.
